notes.title: Torn Veil Release hot fix
notes.content:
Huge thank you for those who downloaded and played the game!

With the release going forward I will read and try to fix and improve the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed ending Dialogue triggering twice.
[*] Fixed mouse sensitivity not being applied properly.
[*] Fixed garage letter and widget mismatch.
[/list]

These bugs are fixed now and many smaller ones. If you encounter bugs you may talk about it in the discussion of the game as I am actively reading them. 

Thank you all again.

-KenshiDev

notes.title: Torn Veil is out! - PLAY NOW with 3 available endings
notes.content:
[h3][b]The veil has been torn… and there's no going back.[/b][/h3][h3][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491595/5e937d2f532bda2fef06ba56979e9e80c6e599c8.png"][/img][/h3][p]After months of development, fear, and mystery — [b]Torn Veil[/b] is officially live on Steam.[/p][p]🕯️ [b]Enter a twisted house where souls are tested, memories are fractured, and nothing stays dead for long.[/b]
Explore a haunting house that seems to remember you. Uncover what happened to the scientists behind the soul experiment, and survive the presence that lurks behind every corner.[/p][p]🔪 [b]Features[/b]
– A story-driven psychological horror experience
– Puzzles, hidden lore, and twisted AI entities
– Arabic and English support
– Designed by a solo Iraqi developer[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who supported, wishlisted, tested, or even just cheered silently from the shadows.
Now it’s your turn to uncover the truth beneath the veil.[/p][p][b]Play it. Survive it. Remember it.[/b]
— [i]KenshiDev[/i][/p]
